integrity: The supporting numerical matrix checks are finite tests, not an exhaustive proof. The all-N statement follows from explicit graph edge enumeration, detailed balance and the length-two return-loop phase obstruction.
scientific_limitations: Point initial states with 0<theta<pi/N and N>=7 only; weak, not total-variation, spatial convergence; geometric Fourier rates are modewise and not uniform in N, theta or mode. No conclusion about global mixing at rational alpha. Mathematical and literature priority have not been independently validated.
title: Conditional spatial mixing on rational Feres billiard angle classes
